conventions.notes: The crops are concept, mechanism and diagram figures; no scope figure was cropped, so yield placement, yield format, conditions split and yield separator are null. substrate_layout is null: crop 02 writes the substrates inline with a plus (panel D), while crop 10 stacks the radical precursor above the alkene with a plus between them, so no two crops agree. new_bond_color is null: only crop 02 draws the newly formed bond (tBu-CH2) in green (#26A83E), and no other crop shows a coloured new bond. reagent_text_color #000000 holds for most reagent text (crops 02 and 05); the exceptions are NaBr in navy (crop 02), the bold red HAT label (crop 09) and the blue Blue LEDs label (crop 08). compound_label_color #000000 holds for crops 05 and 07; C4 is green in crop 03, and crop 04 colours the complex labels C2 to C5 by series. Bold compound labels appear in crops 03 (C4), 05 (t-DCZCB) and 07 (Int-III, CoIII-4(Ag)+, CoIII-5, CoII-6); plain chemical names in crop 03 are not compound labels. Bold intermediate and catalyst-state labels: Int-I and Int-II (crop 01), Int-III and the CoIII and CoII species (crop 07), Ir(III) and Ir(IV) (green) and LnCo (crop 08). arrow_length_over_bond_length 3.2 is the mean of crops 01, 05 and 08 (3.0 to 3.4); crops 02 and 07 give 5.5 and 5.0, so the spread across crops is 3.0 to 5.5. bond_length_over_cap_height 2.06 sits within the 2.0 to 2.2 spread of crops 01, 02, 05, 07 and 08. Halogen atoms drawn as filled discs (Br pink #CC6AE5, Cl blue #4F8EDB) in crops 01, 07, 08, 10, all from one paper. bold_width null: no solid wedge measurable in the cropped regions. measured.label_font is null: no crop measures a font; the Arial label font comes from the acs1996 preset, and the crops read as sans-serif by eye.

evidence.citation: Gilmour et al., JACS Au 2025 (Chloroalkylation of unactivated alkenes via a cobalt-mediated radical ligand transfer)
evidence.observations: Panels framed by a thin grey #B1BDBD border, bold panel titles with (A) letters set into the frame line; the this-work row headed '(C) Our Platform' on a dotted blue rule; Cl and Br as blue #4F8EDB and pink #CC6AE5 discs; radicals as blue orbital lobes; photocatalyst as dark navy #000050 discs; boxed substrates with teal #7ABECB frames.

evidence.citation: Ravelli et al., JACS Au 2025 (A decarbonylative strategy to enhance efficiency and regioselectivity in photocatalyzed HAT)
evidence.observations: Five panels A-E with bold uppercase letters (no parentheses) and bold titles; 'This work' as panel E at the bottom; grey boxes #DEE2E3 hold bullet lists and the photocatalyst; abstracted H red #FE0000; substituents as orange #FFAA73, green and blue #7CBEF0 discs; green #26A83E flag for the activating group; outlined light bulb above the arrow.

evidence.citation: Steffen et al., JACS Au 2025 (Photoactive neutral three-coordinate Cu(I) complexes of anionic N-heterocyclic carbenes)
evidence.observations: Triplet energies on one horizontal eV axis (1.7-2.9 eV, grey tick labels); each sensitizer as a vertical bar capped by filled discs, navy #213570; the new complex C4 green #369134 with a bold green label; labels lie above the axis for Cu(dpp)2+, Cu(bcp)(xant)+ and C4, and below it for Ru(bpy)3, Ir(ppy)3, Ir(dFppy)3 and Ir(p-F-ppy)3, so they do not strictly alternate.

evidence.citation: Steffen et al., JACS Au 2025 (Photoactive neutral three-coordinate Cu(I) complexes of anionic N-heterocyclic carbenes)
evidence.observations: Frontier orbital energies as coloured dots per complex in two boxed panels (unoccupied, occupied); y axis 'Energy / eV'; complex names bold in their series colour, red #F90000, orange #FFA300, green, navy #000085.

bold sans-serif panel titles with the panel letter; crop 01 sets them into a thin grey #B1BDBD frame line, crop 02 as free headings
abstract substituents as coloured discs (orange #FFAA73, blue #7CBEF0, green) and halogens as filled discs (Br pink #CC6AE5, Cl blue #4F8EDB)
grey boxes #DEE2E3 hold bullet-point lists with square bullets (crop 02)
the transferred H atom in red #FE0000 (crop 02)
radicals drawn as blue orbital lobes on the radical carbon (crop 01)
concept_panel.notes: panel_label_style null: bold (A) in crop 01, bare bold A in crop 02, neither enum value fits. background_fill is white in crops 01 and 02; the #DEE2E3 grey only fills boxes inside the panels (the TAG bullet box and the photocatalyst box in crop 02).

signature_features: excited-state (triplet) energies along one horizontal eV axis with grey tick labels, unit written '/ eV' at the axis end
each compound as a vertical bar capped by filled discs, navy #213570; the new compound highlighted in green #369134 with a bold green label
orbital energies as coloured dots per compound in boxed panels with an 'Energy / eV' axis (crop 04)

reactor types as grey tubes with black end fittings; the authors' reactor ('e) This work') drawn with red #FE0000 tubing and photocatalyst disc, its coil outlined in red (crop 06)

grey bold 'PFA tubing' label, blue bold polymer formula and bold figure heading (crop 06)
